lead: An expression-bodied `fn (): void => Something();` panics `nvs-codegen`, and the block-bodied form of the same anonymous function does not.
body: `Core\Out::capture(fn (): void => M::run())` dies with `nvs-codegen does not lower an operand used before it is defined`, while `fn (): void => { M::run(); }` and `fn (): int => M::n()` both run, so it is the `void` return that is unlowerable. Write the braces; the panic names neither the anonymous function nor its return type.
